# Artforum

> > Artforum is the leading international magazine of contemporary art, featuring critical essays, artist profiles, exhibition reviews, and art world news.

Artforum covers contemporary art practice, theory, and criticism across visual arts, photography, film, and institutional developments. The publication provides in-depth features on emerging and established artists, critical analysis of art movements, and comprehensive coverage of gallery openings, museum exhibitions, and art world appointments.

## Key Topics

- Contemporary art
- Art criticism
- Photography and materiality
- Political art and anti-totalitarian movements
- Artist features and profiles
- Art theory
- Museum and institutional news
- Exhibition reviews
- Digital art and technology
- Latin American art
- Photographic techniques
- Collective intelligence in art
- Film festivals and cinema
- Gallery closures and openings
- Art world leadership appointments

## Major Art World News

- [Rachel Wetzler and Daniel Wenger Named Co-Editors of Artforum](https://www.artforum.com/news/rachel-wetzler-daniel-wenger-to-lead-artforum-editorial-1234743670): Wetzler and Wenger appointed co-editors in Artforum restructure
- [Agnes Gund Dies at 87](https://www.artforum.com/news/agnes-gund-dies-19382025-1234735818): MoMA board chair Agnes Gund dies at 87
- [Smithsonian Leader Meets With Trump as Museum Quietly Shutters Latin American Art Gallery](https://www.artforum.com/news/smithsonian-leader-meets-trump-shutters-latin-american-gallery-1234735008): Smithsonian's Bunch meets Trump as Latin American gallery closes
- [MoMA PS 1 Announces Three-Year Free Admission Initiative](https://www.artforum.com/news/moma-ps1-to-make-admission-free-to-all-for-3-years-1234740435): MoMA PS1 to offer free admission 2026-2028 in Long Island City
- [Centre Pompidou Expands into South America with Brazilian Outpost](https://www.artforum.com/news/centre-pompidou-expands-south-america-brazilian-outpost-1234732126): Centre Pompidou opens first South American satellite in Brazil 2027

## Artist Features and Critical Essays

- [Fugitive Processes: The Materiality of Photography](https://www.artforum.com/features/the-materiality-of-photography-1234736993): Feature exploring photography's material futures and techniques
- [Margarita Paksa's anti-totalitarian art—a feature by Daniel R. Quiles](https://www.artforum.com/features/margarita-paksa-anti-totalitarian-art-daniel-r-quiles-1234743980): Daniel R. Quiles examines Paksa's 1970s work confronting Argentina's regime
- [Manuel Felguérez's La Máquina estética analyzed by Doreen Ríos](https://www.artforum.com/features/manuel-felguerez-la-maquina-estetica-digital-art-1234733873): Doreen Ríos on Felguérez's La Máquina estética and digital art history
- [Agnieszka Kurant on Collective Intelligence—A Feature by Christy Lange](https://www.artforum.com/features/agnieszka-kurant-collective-intelligence-christy-lange-1234733866): Christy Lange profiles Kurant's work on non-human collective intelligence
- [Eddie Arroyo Paints a Vandalized Miami Memorial to Anti-Black Violence](https://www.artforum.com/features/close-up-eddie-arroyo-miami-crisis-of-memory-1234742132): Martinez examines Arroyo's painting of vandalized Miami memorial
- [Noam M. Elcott on Franz Wilhelm Seiwert's Mural for a Photographer](https://www.artforum.com/features/franz-wilhelm-seiwert-close-up-noam-m-elcott-1234737016): Elcott examines Seiwert's 1925 painting Mural for a Photographer
- [Artforum's Theo Belci on the work of Mimosa Echard](https://www.artforum.com/features/mimosa-echard-spotlight-1234742325): Theo Belci spotlights Mimosa Echard's sculptures and installations

## Film and Cinema Coverage

- [Jordan Cronk on the 78th Cannes Film Festival](https://www.artforum.com/columns/jordan-cronk-78th-cannes-film-festival-1234732150): Jordan Cronk reviews films by Diaz, Gan, Laxe, Panahi at Cannes

## Gallery and Museum News

- [Pulitzer Prize–Winning Art Critic Christopher Knight Departs LA Times](https://www.artforum.com/news/la-times-art-critic-christopher-knight-retires-1234739819): Christopher Knight retires after 36 years as LA Times art critic
- [British Museum, Charity, Launch $5.3 Million Public Appeal to Keep Rare Barbara Hepworth Sculpture in Country](https://www.artforum.com/news/barbara-hepworth-sculpture-fundraiser-5-3-million-1234732186): Hepworth Wakefield raises $5.3M for Barbara Hepworth's 1943 sculpture
- [Altman Siegel Closes in San Francisco](https://www.artforum.com/news/altman-siegel-closes-san-francisco-1234736764): Altman Siegel Gallery closes after 16 years in San Francisco
- [Serpentine's Kostas Stasinopoulos to Lead Greece's Kyklos](https://www.artforum.com/news/serpentines-kostas-stasinopoulos-to-helm-greeces-kyklos-1234744795): Stasinopoulos named director of Greece's Kyklos center for African art
